subjects.description: A vehicle approaching the intersection at speed and failing to stop at a red traffic signal
subjects.appearance_details: Single vehicle viewed from overhead — rooftop and shadow visible, moving faster than surrounding traffic
subjects.relationship: Primary subject — the red-light-running vehicle initiating the conflict
subjects.location: Approaches from one of the controlled lanes visible in the provided image
subjects.relative_size: Single vehicle viewed from overhead, similar scale to other vehicles in the scene
subjects.orientation: Facing toward and through the intersection along its approach lane
subjects.pose: Upright, wheels contacting the road, moving forward at speed
subjects.action: Approaches the stop line at above-normal speed without any deceleration. Crosses the stop line and pedestrian crossing while the traffic signal remains red, entering the intersection box at speed. Continues through without stopping and exits the far side.
subjects.state_changes: Maintains speed throughout — no braking or deceleration visible at the stop line — and clears the intersection without stopping

subjects.description: Cross-traffic vehicles that have a green signal and are moving through the intersection simultaneously
subjects.appearance_details: Multiple vehicles in perpendicular lanes, viewed from above, moving at normal speed
subjects.relationship: Cross traffic — vehicles with right-of-way reacting to the violation
subjects.location: Perpendicular approach lanes and intersection box
subjects.relative_size: Multiple vehicles of similar overhead scale to the primary subject
subjects.orientation: Facing along the cross-street direction, perpendicular to the violating vehicle
subjects.pose: Upright, wheels contacting the road; transitions to hard-braking posture with slight lateral steering
subjects.action: Enter the intersection on a green signal at normal speed. React to the red-light-running vehicle with sudden hard braking and slight lateral steering to avoid a collision. One or more vehicles come to a complete stop within the intersection box. After the running vehicle clears, traffic resumes cautiously.
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from normal green-light movement to emergency braking and evasive maneuvering, then gradual cautious resumption

background_setting: A four-way signalized intersection viewed from a fixed elevated surveillance camera. The traffic signal visible in the scene remains red for the approaching violating vehicle throughout the event. Lane markings, stop lines, pedestrian crossings, and signal heads are clearly visible. All scene geometry and camera perspective are preserved exactly. Use the provided image as the exact first frame.

lighting.conditions: Consistent daylight as established in the seed image
lighting.shadows: Short vehicle shadows consistent with overhead lighting in the seed image
lighting.illumination_effect: Clear, even illumination providing good visibility of all vehicles, their speeds, lane markings, and signal states
lighting.sky: Clear or lightly overcast daytime sky, consistent with the seed image

aesthetics.composition: Fixed overhead intersection framing, matching the seed image
aesthetics.color_scheme: Natural daylight tones — gray asphalt, painted lane markings, varied vehicle colors
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Tense, sudden hazard within an otherwise routine daytime scene
aesthetics.patterns: Sharp contrast between the speeding violator and the abrupt braking of cross traffic

cinematography.camera_motion: Fixed — the camera does not pan, tilt, or zoom
cinematography.framing: Wide overhead establishing shot of the full intersection
cinematography.depth_of_field: Deep — all lanes and vehicles remain in focus
cinematography.camera_preservation: Use the provided image as the exact first frame and preserve its perspective and framing throughout

context: A vehicle runs a red light and crosses paths with cross traffic that has right-of-way, forcing evasive braking with no collision
negative_prompt: actual collision or contact between vehicles, vehicle stopping at the red light, multiple vehicles running the red light, teleporting vehicles, flickering, camera motion, pan, tilt, zoom, added pedestrians, added signage, nighttime, changed lane markings
